name: Challenge Overlord Mok'Morokk
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
You dare challenge Overlord Mok'Morokk?

Haw!

Me crush tiny friend!

You tell me when ready for good beating.
narrative.objectives: Defeat Mok'Morokk and report the news to Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village.
narrative.offerRewardText:
That cowardly fat mass Mok'Morokk fled like a scared child. You have done a great service, adventurer.

Now my people can appoint a new leader, one who will help us reclaim our old home once and for all.
narrative.requestItemsText: I thought you were going to attempt to drive Mok'Morokk out of the village. Instead you have come to me to chat?
narrative.endText: Drive Overlord Mok'Morokk from Brackenwall Village
